source: the stylesheet bodies read during live loads of the home and a product page on drinkdouze.com (theme.css, douze-custom.css and the cross-origin checkout-button sheet from network responses plus the inline <style> blocks — the :root token block and the per-section scopes — re-parsed with CSSStyleSheet); resolved in a probe carrying the real sheets at :root at 1440 x 900; the site paints light only

context: @supports (color: color-contrast(wheat vs black, white)) and (color: rgb(from wheat r g b / 0.07))

properties.--button-overlay-color:
rgb(
        from color-contrast(rgb(var(--button-background)) vs white, black) r g b /
          7%
      )
